title: Why 80% of Americans Can't Save

scenes.fact: Only about 16% of Americans have enough savings to cover three months of expenses.
scenes.text: 80% of Americans are struggling to save money.
A recent survey found that 27% of Americans have no savings at all.
But, small consistent habits can change everything!
Follow for daily money habits that actually work.

description: Discover why so many Americans struggle with savings and how tiny changes can lead to big financial improvements. Follow us for essential money wisdom!
